matchupOfTheWeek.title: Rush Offense vs. Run Defense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our rush offense grades 58/100 (about average) against CHI's run defense at 13/100 (among the NFL's worst) — the widest statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: Thursday night in Chicago presents the most lopsided matchup on this week's board: our rush offense (58/100) gets to feast on the Bears' run defense (13/100), quite possibly the worst in the league. The problem is their pass rush (94/100) is among the NFL's elite, and our pass protection (61/100), while above average, may have its hands full—especially with A.J. Brown still shaking off that ankle injury and Romeo Doubs now on IR after his 42-yard TD catch last week. Drake Maye's been sharp (three TDs against the Jets), but this is a night where we'll need to lean ground game early and often. We're 4-1 in the last five meetings, riding a modest edge in recent form (0.19 EPA/play over three games vs. Chicago's -0.05), and we're favored on the road—all good signs, but that Bears pass rush is real.
